name: non-mendelian genetics overview
title: Non-Mendelian inheritance: mitochondrial DNA disease passes only through the mother and varies by heteroplasmy and threshold, nuclear mitochondrial disease follows Mendelian patterns, and triple nucleotide repeat disorders (Huntington disease, myotonic dystrophy) are autosomal dominant with anticipation, read by repeat size; each column gives inheritance, presentation, testing and treatment

nodes.title: Non-Mendelian inheritance: WHAT does the family tree and the patient show?
lines: • high-energy tissues (brain, retina, skeletal muscle, heart) in 2 or more systems → MITOCHONDRIAL

• suggestive: CNS (hypotonia, ataxia, intellectual disability, seizures, migraine, dementia, sensorineural hearing loss) · eyes (retinitis pigmentosa, optic atrophy, nystagmus, ophthalmoplegia) · muscle weakness, exercise intolerance · heart (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, heart block)
• also: macrocytic anemia, pancytopenia · diabetes mellitus or insipidus, exocrine pancreas, short stature · gut pseudo-obstruction · liver failure · renal tubular acidosis, Fanconi
• worse and EARLIER in each generation → triple nucleotide REPEAT (anticipation)

nodes.title: MITOCHONDRIAL disorders
lines: ↓ ATP · dual control by nuclear + mitochondrial genes
pyruvate dehydrogenase · Krebs cycle · respiratory chain · mtDNA upkeep

nodes.title: Triple nucleotide REPEAT disorders
lines: autosomal dominant · bigger repeat = earlier, more severe

nodes.title: Mitochondrial DNA disease
lines: point mutations: MATERNAL · deletions, duplications: sporadic
circular mtDNA, 37 genes · 1-10 copies per mitochondrion

nodes.title: Nuclear-gene mitochondrial disease
lines: follows MENDELIAN inheritance

nodes.title: Huntington disease
lines: polyglutamine huntingtin aggregates in neurons
death about 54-55, 15-25 years after onset

nodes.title: Myotonic dystrophy
lines: myotonia: cannot relax after contracting

nodes.title: Varies by tissue and worsens
lines: • HETEROPLASMY: mutant + normal mtDNA, shared out at random
• symptoms once a tissue passes its THRESHOLD
• mutant mtDNA accumulates in neurons, muscle → progressive

nodes.title: Why only the mother
lines: egg: many mitochondria · sperm: few · genetic bottleneck

nodes.title: e.g. depletion syndromes
lines: • nuclear genes for mtDNA nucleotides or replication
• too little mtDNA → too little energy

nodes.title: Onset 35-44 years
lines: • 2/3 neurologic (chorea), 1/3 psychiatric
• MRI: CAUDATE atrophy, diffuse cortical atrophy
• JUVENILE (60-100 repeats): rigidity, seizures, little chorea, rapid

nodes.title: Stages
lines: • early: clumsy, minor movements, personality, psychiatric · still works
• middle: chorea, dysarthria, dysphagia, weight loss, cognitive decline · basic self-care kept
• late: dependent, mute, incontinent, rigid, cannot walk, choking

nodes.title: cases
lines: • 45, arm and leg movements · mother had head movements
• 13, juvenile HD, 65 repeats · father 40, 47 repeats, still healthy (anticipation)

nodes.title: Grip will not let go
lines: • ptosis · narrow face · balding · cataracts · arrhythmia
• case: 25, cannot let go of jars, keys · fatigue · father had cataracts in his 40s

nodes.title: CONGENITAL
lines: • floppy newborn, respiratory failure, high neonatal death
• myopathic face: expressionless, sunken cheeks, ptosis
• survivors: hypotonia improves · conduction defects, cognition
• check the MOTHER

nodes.title: CAG repeat count
lines: • 26 or fewer: normal
• 27-35: premutation, child at risk
• 36-39: reduced penetrance
• 40 or more: WILL develop HD

nodes.title: Pre-symptomatic test
lines: • only after counselling by a geneticist or genetic counsellor
• 70-80% of relatives decline · some never return for results
• ask: support, coping, reasons (uncertainty, children)

nodes.title: Symptomatic test
lines: any physician (usually neurology), any age

nodes.title: CTG repeat count
lines: • 35-49: premutation, no signs
• 50-150: mild, cataracts
• about 100-1000: classic, onset 10-30
• over 1000: congenital

nodes.title: Suspect it: 2 or more systems
lines: • ↑ blood and cerebrospinal fluid lactate
• MRI or spectroscopy: lactate peak, basal ganglia, leukodystrophy, atrophy
• muscle biopsy: immunohistochemistry, respiratory chain enzymes
• mtDNA and nuclear gene panels

nodes.title: No effective treatment
lines: • mitochondrial cocktail (respiratory chain cofactors): riboflavin, coenzyme Q10, thiamine

nodes.title: Supportive
lines: • genetic counselling · family planning
• prenatal and preimplantation diagnosis
